jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Role Description
This role is for a Junior Data Analyst responsible for supporting data-driven decision-making through data collection, analysis, validation, and reporting. In this position, you will assist in transforming raw data into meaningful insights that support business operations, performance monitoring, and strategic initiatives.
As a Junior Data Analyst, you will work with datasets from multiple sources, helping to clean, organize, and prepare data for analysis. You will support senior analysts or cross-functional teams by performing structured analyses, identifying basic trends and patterns, and ensuring data accuracy and consistency.
Key responsibilities include maintaining datasets, performing data validation checks, and assisting with routine analytical tasks. You will help generate reports, dashboards, and summaries that communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You will collaborate with teams across departments to understand data requirements, support reporting needs, and contribute to ongoing analytics projects. This role provides exposure to real-world data workflows, business metrics, and analytical processes, making it ideal for individuals looking to develop foundational data analysis skills.
The Junior Data Analyst role requires strong attention to detail, logical thinking, and a willingness to learn. You will be expected to follow data standards, document assumptions, and ensure that outputs are accurate, timely, and aligned with business objectives.
Clear communication skills are important, as you will assist in explaining data findings and supporting informed decision-making. By providing reliable analytical support, the Junior Data Analyst plays an important role in enabling data-driven insights and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities
Collect, clean, and organize data from multiple sources
Perform basic data analysis to identify trends and patterns
Validate data accuracy and consistency
Maintain and update datasets and data documentation
Assist in creating reports, dashboards, and summaries
Support ad-hoc data requests and routine analytical tasks
Collaborate with analysts and stakeholders on data requirements
Document methodologies, assumptions, and data sources
Support performance tracking and operational reporting
Follow data quality and governance standards

Qualifications
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
High attention to detail and data accuracy
Ability to work with structured datasets
Proficiency with spreadsheets and basic analysis tools
Basic understanding of data analysis concepts and metrics
Ability to create clear reports and summaries
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
Willingness to learn and develop analytical skills
Educational background in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred

jobs.title: Entry-Level Technical Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.

Problem-solving with a purpose.

As a Technical Solutions Engineer at Epic, you’ll work on software that impacts 305 million patients around the world. Alongside customer counterparts, you’ll tackle mission-critical and complex problems – we’re way beyond “turn it off and on again” issues. You’ll need to diagnose the problem, identify a solution, and manage the implementation of the solution, sometimes across multiple physical locations and stakeholders. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/Jobs/Technical-Solutions-Engineer.

Test the limits of your brain for the most innovative health systems on the planet.

The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.

Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.

Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).

More than just important work
.

Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.

We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.

Bachelor's degree or greater
A history of academic excellence or professional success
Willingness to travel occasionally to customer locations
Eligible to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship
Relocation to the Madison, WI area (reimbursed)
COVID-19 vaccination

jobs.title: Data analyst (H/F)
jobs.description:
Role Overview
The Data Analyst (H/F) is responsible for transforming complex datasets into clear, actionable insights that support strategic planning and operational improvement. This role involves gathering data from various sources, performing detailed analyses, and presenting findings to stakeholders across the organization. The Data Analyst ensures data accuracy, builds reporting tools, and contributes to the development of data-driven solutions. This position is ideal for analytical professionals who enjoy problem-solving, critical thinking, and working with diverse teams.
Key Responsibilities
• Collect, clean, and organize data from multiple systems and databases to ensure high-quality datasets.
• Perform exploratory and advanced analyses to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for optimization.
• Design and maintain dashboards, automated reports, and visualization tools for internal teams.
• Collaborate with departments such as marketing, operations, finance, and product to understand analytical needs.
• Support performance tracking by monitoring KPIs and providing regular updates.
• Translate complex analytical results into clear, understandable insights for decision-makers.
• Assist in the development of forecasting models and analytical methodologies.
• Document data processes, standards, and definitions to strengthen data governance.
• Conduct quality checks on datasets and recommend improvements for data integrity.
• Stay informed about emerging tools, techniques, and best practices in analytics.
Qualifications and Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related discipline.
• 1–3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a similar analytical role.
• Proficiency with analytical tools such as SQL, Excel, Python, or R.
• Experience working with visualization platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent tools.
• Strong understanding of analytical methods, statistical concepts, and data modeling.
• High attention to detail with strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Comfortable managing multiple tasks and deadlines in a dynamic environment.
• Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills for cross-functional teamwork.
• Proactive mindset with a desire to learn, improve processes, and contribute to data-driven culture.
Summary
The Data Analyst (H/F) plays a vital role in enabling informed decision-making across the organization. By analyzing data, developing meaningful insights, and collaborating with key stakeholders, this role supports growth, efficiency, and strategic direction. It is well-suited for analytical and detail-oriented professionals committed to delivering accurate and impactful insights.

new_jobs.description:
Role Description
This role is for a Junior Data Analyst responsible for supporting data-driven decision-making through data collection, analysis, validation, and reporting. In this position, you will assist in transforming raw data into meaningful insights that support business operations, performance monitoring, and strategic initiatives.
As a Junior Data Analyst, you will work with datasets from multiple sources, helping to clean, organize, and prepare data for analysis. You will support senior analysts or cross-functional teams by performing structured analyses, identifying basic trends and patterns, and ensuring data accuracy and consistency.
Key responsibilities include maintaining datasets, performing data validation checks, and assisting with routine analytical tasks. You will help generate reports, dashboards, and summaries that communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You will collaborate with teams across departments to understand data requirements, support reporting needs, and contribute to ongoing analytics projects. This role provides exposure to real-world data workflows, business metrics, and analytical processes, making it ideal for individuals looking to develop foundational data analysis skills.
The Junior Data Analyst role requires strong attention to detail, logical thinking, and a willingness to learn. You will be expected to follow data standards, document assumptions, and ensure that outputs are accurate, timely, and aligned with business objectives.
Clear communication skills are important, as you will assist in explaining data findings and supporting informed decision-making. By providing reliable analytical support, the Junior Data Analyst plays an important role in enabling data-driven insights and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities
Collect, clean, and organize data from multiple sources
Perform basic data analysis to identify trends and patterns
Validate data accuracy and consistency
Maintain and update datasets and data documentation
Assist in creating reports, dashboards, and summaries
Support ad-hoc data requests and routine analytical tasks
Collaborate with analysts and stakeholders on data requirements
Document methodologies, assumptions, and data sources
Support performance tracking and operational reporting
Follow data quality and governance standards

Qualifications
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
High attention to detail and data accuracy
Ability to work with structured datasets
Proficiency with spreadsheets and basic analysis tools
Basic understanding of data analysis concepts and metrics
Ability to create clear reports and summaries
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
Willingness to learn and develop analytical skills
Educational background in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred

new_jobs.title: Data analyst (H/F)
new_jobs.description:
Role Overview
The Data Analyst (H/F) is responsible for transforming complex datasets into clear, actionable insights that support strategic planning and operational improvement. This role involves gathering data from various sources, performing detailed analyses, and presenting findings to stakeholders across the organization. The Data Analyst ensures data accuracy, builds reporting tools, and contributes to the development of data-driven solutions. This position is ideal for analytical professionals who enjoy problem-solving, critical thinking, and working with diverse teams.
Key Responsibilities
• Collect, clean, and organize data from multiple systems and databases to ensure high-quality datasets.
• Perform exploratory and advanced analyses to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for optimization.
• Design and maintain dashboards, automated reports, and visualization tools for internal teams.
• Collaborate with departments such as marketing, operations, finance, and product to understand analytical needs.
• Support performance tracking by monitoring KPIs and providing regular updates.
• Translate complex analytical results into clear, understandable insights for decision-makers.
• Assist in the development of forecasting models and analytical methodologies.
• Document data processes, standards, and definitions to strengthen data governance.
• Conduct quality checks on datasets and recommend improvements for data integrity.
• Stay informed about emerging tools, techniques, and best practices in analytics.
Qualifications and Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related discipline.
• 1–3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a similar analytical role.
• Proficiency with analytical tools such as SQL, Excel, Python, or R.
• Experience working with visualization platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent tools.
• Strong understanding of analytical methods, statistical concepts, and data modeling.
• High attention to detail with strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Comfortable managing multiple tasks and deadlines in a dynamic environment.
• Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills for cross-functional teamwork.
• Proactive mindset with a desire to learn, improve processes, and contribute to data-driven culture.
Summary
The Data Analyst (H/F) plays a vital role in enabling informed decision-making across the organization. By analyzing data, developing meaningful insights, and collaborating with key stakeholders, this role supports growth, efficiency, and strategic direction. It is well-suited for analytical and detail-oriented professionals committed to delivering accurate and impactful insights.

Test the limits of your brain for the most innovative health systems on the planet.

Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.

Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. .
